add_hint: One link per line (http:// or https://). Add "|name" after a link to choose the file name.
add_received_hint: Choose the queue and folder, then press Add to queue.
bye_msg: Send the payload to the console again to start it.
dl_sub: Queues, progress and controls for everything you download.
dup_done: Added - this link was downloaded before
dup_listed: Already in the list - not added again
empty_msg: Press "Add links", use the Link grabber, or drop a links.txt into the watch folder and it is picked up automatically.
err_link_rejected: Link was rejected (must be http:// or https://)
exit_msg: Running downloads are paused and saved. To use the Download Manager again you have to send the payload to the console again.
fm_hint: Pick a folder on the console or on a USB / extended drive.
grab_cut: (The page was large, the list is cut off.)
grab_diag: Page loaded (HTTP {code}, {kb} KB, title: "{title}"). If the site builds its download links with JavaScript they cannot be read here - on a PC use the site's own copy-links button and paste them into Add links.
grab_hint: Type the address of a page. The console loads it and lists the files it links to (zip, iso, pkg, mp4, ...).
grab_more: Showing the first {shown} of {n} - use the filter to narrow down.
grab_none_files: No file links found on this page. Turn on "Show all links" to see everything.
grab_show_all: Show all links, not only files
grab_sub: Scan a web page for download links and add the ones you want.
q_all_hint: Showing all queues. Pick a queue to start or stop it, set parallel downloads, a timer, rename or delete it.
q_delete_msg: Delete queue "{name}"? Its downloads move to Main Queue.
q_limit_label: Total speed for this queue in KB/s (0 = unlimited)
set_exit_d: Stops the Download Manager on the console. Downloads are paused and saved.
set_folder_d: New downloads go here unless you choose another folder.
set_notify_d: Show a PS5 notification when downloads finish or fail.
set_retries_d: How often a broken connection is retried before the download fails.
set_segments_d: More connections can speed up a download if the server allows it.
set_sub: How downloads behave and where they are saved.
timer_enable: Start and stop this queue automatically
timer_hint: Uses the time of the device you are using right now. The queue starts at the start time and stops at the stop time (a window like 23:00 - 06:00 across midnight works). Start/Stop queue still works by hand in between.
